profile.headline: U.S. Navy Veteran || Entrepreneur || Full Stack Web Developer || Studying at LEARN Academy
profile.summary:
Hi, I'm Evelyn. I am a student at Learn Academy and I'm learning multiple tech language skills to become a full stack web developer. I come from a military law enforcement background and I am transitioning into the tech industry.

We use technology in EVERYTHING that we do! I have always wanted to learn about technology and how it works but never had the time to focus on my education because I was always working in other fields. Now that I'm retired from the Navy, I have the time to focus on my passion for learning about web development. I am fascinated by how technology works behind the scenes and what coding entails.

In a matter of weeks, I have learned several tech languages and software such as HTML, JavaScript, CSS, Ruby, Ruby on Rails, Tailwind, React, Trello, Notion, ESlint, Standardrb, PostgresSQL, Git, GitHub, VS Code Editor, Postman, etc. and I am interested in learning so much more.

My goal is to utilize my skills as a web developer and eventually gain employment and more coding experience with a tech company.
